verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ לִ֔י כְּאָ֣ח יוֹנֵ֖ק אִמִּ֑י שְׁדֵ֣י אֶֽמְצָאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹא־ יָב֥וּזוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·ten·ḵā lî kə·’āḥ yō·w·nêq ’im·mî šə·ḏê ’em·ṣā·’ă·ḵā ḇa·ḥūṣ ʾɛ·šå̄·qə·ḵå̄ gam lō- yā·ḇū·zū lî
verses.literal: O that you [were] to me like a brother who nursed at my mother’s breasts If I found you outdoors I would kiss you and no one would despise me

verses.original: אֶנְהָֽגֲךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑נִי הָרֶ֔קַח מִיַּ֣יִן אַשְׁקְךָ֙ מֵעֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’en·hā·ḡă·ḵā ’ă·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- bêṯ ’im·mî tə·lam·mə·ḏê·nî hā·re·qaḥ mî·ya·yin ’aš·qə·ḵā mê·‘ă·sîs rim·mō·nî
verses.literal: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me I would give you spiced wine to drink the nectar of my pomegranates
His left hand is under my head and his right arm embraces me

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מַה־ הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם תָּעִ֧ירוּ׀ וּֽמַה־ תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־ הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim mah- hiš·ba‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem tā·‘î·rū ū·mah- tə·‘ō·rə·rū ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ‘aḏ šet·teḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: O daughters of Jerusalem . . . I adjure you Do not arouse . . . or awaken - love until the time is right

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־ הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל־ דּוֹדָ֑הּ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔יךָ תַּ֤חַת הַתַּפּ֙וּחַ֙ שָׁ֚מָּה אִמֶּ֔ךָ חִבְּלַ֣תְךָ שָׁ֖מָּה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mî zōṯ ‘ō·lāh min- ham·miḏ·bār miṯ·rap·pe·qeṯ ‘al- dō·w·ḏāh ‘ō·w·rar·tî·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ hat·tap·pū·aḥ šām·māh ’im·me·ḵā ḥib·bə·laṯ·ḵā šām·māh ḥib·bə·lāh yə·lā·ḏaṯ·ḵā
verses.literal: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning on her beloved I roused you under the apple tree there your mother conceived you there she travailed and brought you forth

verses.original: שִׂימֵ֨נִי כַֽחוֹתָ֜ם עַל־ לִבֶּ֗ךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם֙ עַל־ זְרוֹעֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ אַהֲבָ֔ה עַזָּ֤ה כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ קִנְאָ֑ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִשְׁא֖וֹל רְשָׁפֶ֕יהָ אֵ֖שׁ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י שַׁלְהֶ֥בֶתְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śî·mê·nî ḵa·ḥō·w·ṯām ‘al- lib·be·ḵā ka·ḥō·w·ṯām ‘al- zə·rō·w·‘e·ḵā kî- ’a·hă·ḇāh ‘az·zāh ḵam·mā·weṯ qin·’āh qā·šāh ḵiš·’ō·wl rə·šā·p̄e·hā ’êš riš·pê šal·he·ḇeṯ·yāh
verses.literal: Set me as a seal over your heart as a seal upon your arm For love is as strong as death its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol Its sparks are fiery flames the fiercest blaze of all

verses.original: רַבִּ֗ים מַ֣יִם לֹ֤א יֽוּכְלוּ֙ לְכַבּ֣וֹת אֶת־ הָֽאַהֲבָ֔ה וּנְהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּהָ אִם־ אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־ יִתֵּ֨ן כָּל־ ה֤וֹן בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּאַהֲבָ֔ה בּ֖וֹז יָב֥וּזוּ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm ma·yim lō yū·ḵə·lū lə·ḵab·bō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ū·nə·hā·rō·wṯ lō yiš·ṭə·p̄ū·hā ’im- ’îš ’eṯ- yit·tên kāl- hō·wn bê·ṯōw bā·’a·hă·ḇāh bō·wz yā·ḇū·zū lōw
verses.literal: Mighty waters cannot . . . quench - love rivers cannot sweep it away If a man - were to give all the wealth of his house for love [his offer] would be utterly scorned . . .

verses.original: קְטַנָּ֔ה אָח֥וֹת לָ֙נוּ֙ לָ֑הּ וְשָׁדַ֖יִם אֵ֣ין מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לַאֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ בַּיּ֖וֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ṭan·nāh ’ā·ḥō·wṯ lā·nū lāh wə·šā·ḏa·yim ’ên mah- na·‘ă·śeh la·’ă·ḥō·ṯê·nū bay·yō·wm še·yə·ḏub·bar- bāh
verses.literal: We have a little sister - and her breasts are not yet grown What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for

verses.original: אִם־ הִ֔יא חוֹמָ֣ה נִבְנֶ֥ה טִ֣ירַת כָּ֑סֶף עָלֶ֖יהָ וְאִם־ הִ֔יא דֶּ֣לֶת נָצ֥וּר עָלֶ֖יהָ ל֥וּחַ אָֽרֶז׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- hî ḥō·w·māh niḇ·neh ṭî·raṯ kā·sep̄ ‘ā·le·hā wə·’im- hî de·leṯ nā·ṣūr ‘ā·le·hā lū·aḥ ’ā·rez
verses.literal: If she is a wall we will build a tower of silver upon her If she is a door we will enclose her with panels of cedar

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י חוֹמָ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖י כַּמִּגְדָּל֑וֹת אָ֛ז הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כְּמוֹצְאֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ḥō·w·māh wə·šā·ḏay kam·miḡ·dā·lō·wṯ ’āz hā·yî·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nāw kə·mō·wṣ·’êṯ šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: I am a wall and my breasts are like towers So I have become in his eyes like one who brings peace

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ הָיָ֤ה כֶּ֣רֶם בְּבַ֣עַל הָמ֔וֹן נָתַ֥ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖רֶם לַנֹּטְרִ֑ים בְּפִרְי֖וֹ אִ֛ישׁ יָבִ֥א אֶ֥לֶף כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: liš·lō·mōh hā·yāh ke·rem bə·ḇa·‘al hā·mō·wn nā·ṯan ’eṯ- hak·ke·rem lan·nō·ṭə·rîm bə·p̄ir·yōw ’îš yā·ḇi ’e·lep̄ kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Solomon had a vineyard vvv in Baal-hamon He leased - [it] to the tenants For its fruit each was to bring a thousand [shekels] of silver

verses.original: כָּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לְפָנָ֑י הָאֶ֤לֶף לְךָ֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּמָאתַ֖יִם לְנֹטְרִ֥ים אֶת־ פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kå̄·rə·mī šel·lî lə·p̄ā·nāy hā·’e·lep̄ lə·ḵā šə·lō·mōh ū·mā·ṯa·yim lə·nō·ṭə·rîm ’eṯ- pir·yōw
verses.literal: [But] my own vineyard is mine to give the thousand [shekels] are for you O Solomon and two hundred are for those who tend - its fruit

verses.original: הַיוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּגַּנִּ֗ים חֲבֵרִ֛ים מַקְשִׁיבִ֥ים לְקוֹלֵ֖ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽינִי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·yō·šɛ·ḇɛṯ bag·gan·nîm ḥă·ḇê·rîm maq·šî·ḇîm lə·qō·w·lêḵ haš·mî·‘î·nî
verses.literal: You who dwell in the gardens [my] companions are listening for your voice Let me hear it

verses.original: בְּרַ֣ח׀ דּוֹדִ֗י וּֽדְמֵה־ לְךָ֤ לִצְבִי֙ א֚וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·raḥ dō·w·ḏî ū·ḏə·mêh- lə·ḵā liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm ‘al hā·rê ḇə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: Come away my beloved and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices
